set.body:
Purpose and scope
Extend the generator with assessed observations, repeated derivative releases, explicit source identities and metric name/version/unit combinations. Evaluate expected matches independently and exercise ScientificResults.coverage. Keep the 100-input/100-release bounds until separately justified.

Acceptance proof
Equal bytes in different source releases do not collapse; metric versions and absent/different units never match implicitly; lower bound is inclusive and upper exclusive. Coverage emits every requested input including empty groups. Unauthorized source/derivative fails the whole request, and false external evidence cannot enter accepted indexes. Both catalogs agree.

Start here
modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/DerivativeScience.scala; modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/ScientificResults.scala; modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/ScientificSql.scala; shared/integration tests

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: Q3: Generate exact-input derivative observation and coverage oracle cases
